title: Mishy Mash
style: Mandarin pop with bright syncopated percussion, playful Latin guitar licks, and a bouncy four-on-the-floor pulse; verse stays tight and chatty with close-mic lead and finger-click rhythm, pre-chorus strips to palm-muted plucks and rising harmonies, chorus opens with stacked doubles, chanty backing ad-libs, and a quick key lift. Spanish tag lines, tiny vocal runs, sparkle fills, and a polished glossy mix with punchy low end., pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ruby walks in, paddle in hand
White shoes fresh, sun on the band
Michelle says, “Breathe, small steps”
Watch that line, then split your reps

She feeds that feed, soft and low
Ruby meets it, lets it go
Little grin, then sharper aim
Every miss just teaches game

[Pre-Chorus]
Mishy mash, turn and strike
Find the gap, then take the lane
One more read, one more bite
Ruby’s eyes go all in now

[Chorus]
Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Michelle made it click, click
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ahora sí, así, así

Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Hands so clean, so slick, slick
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ruby goes pro, sí, sí

[Verse 2]
Corner dink, then crosscourt fire
Move that foot, lift that tire
Michelle calls, “Spin it more”
Ruby paints that edge with score

Backhand block, then drop it dead
Smile stays cool, head ahead
Every drill turns into art
Every point says, “start, start, start”

[Pre-Chorus]
Mishy mash, turn and strike
Read the bounce, then own the space
One more snap, one more swipe
Ruby’s ready for the chase

[Chorus]
Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Michelle made it click, click
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ahora sí, así, así

Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Hands so clean, so slick, slick
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ruby goes pro, sí, sí

[Bridge]
From the sideline to the final line
She don’t blink, she don’t unwind
Michelle nods, “That’s your game”
Ruby steps up, takes her name

[Chorus]
Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Michelle made it click, click
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ahora sí, así, así

Ruby goes pro quick, quick
Hands so clean, so slick, slick
Mishy mash, hit, hit
Ruby goes pro, sí, sí
